rows.note: quest complete; needs The Duviri Paradox and The Lotus Eaters; opens Höllvania

rows.label: Mastery Rank 17
rows.note: enforced at the Eleanor purchase, not at Coda spawn

conditions: Only one adversary at a time: clear or convert any active Kuva Lich, Sister of Parvos, or Coda first.

rows.label: Antivirus mods
rows.alt: transmute 4 depleted mods of one type into a fresh one

conditions: The Antivirus Bounty sits at the top of the Central Mall board and pays the largest Hex standing of any bounty.
bonuses: Antivirus and Potency mods drop as public loot off any squadmate's stab, so pubbing tops you up even when your own Coda hasn't spawned.

groups.meta: ~1 hour to a couple hours per Coda

rows.label: spawn via Exterminate, Hell-Scrub or Legacyte Harvest
rows.note: kill a Techrot for a Mixtape, hack the terminal

rows.label: correct Antivirus mercy
rows.note: equip and test 3 Antivirus mods at once; any one being correct counts

rows.label: 100% disinfection
rows.note: 2 Potency mods once the Antivirus is known; missions alone cap at 95%

conditions: Duets spawn at 25% per mission, +25% per miss, guaranteed on the 4th.
A Duet that stumbles 3 times unstabbed, or a downed squad, flees the encounter.
An active Kuva Lich or Sister of Parvos stops Coda Mixtapes from dropping.
Phases 1 and 3 are hazard-dodging with Transference disabled; phases 2 and 4 are the real fight.
Bring Overguard or invulnerability; Magnetic stage hazards strip Overguard fast, which is why Revenant's Mesmer Skin gets the most praise over Dante, Rhino, Valkyr, Wukong or Nyx.
bonuses: Abort right after a correct-Antivirus stab; the disinfection banks immediately.
Hex bounties that can spawn Duets show a Coda icon and your current Duet chance on hover.
Squadmates who each defeat their own Coda in the same Concert add +1 Heartcell, up to +3, whether they vanquish or convert.

disclosures.title: solo is faster, group now pays a little
disclosures.body: A solo Concert was long the near-unanimous advice for speed. Since Hotfix 38.5.7 a squad earns +1 Heartcell for each Coda defeated past the first, up to +3 in a full squad, so grouping now has a small payoff if everyone brings their own Coda.

groups.meta: Batch A, one copy per 4-day rotation
conditions: Sporothrix is Batch A, alongside Hema, Catabolyst, Pox, Dual Torxica, Mire and Motovore; Batch B carries no Sporothrix.
One purchase per weapon per rotation; rotations flip every 4 days at 0:00 UTC.
An empty weapon slot is required before Eleanor will sell to you.
bonuses: Heartcells are untradeable and only come from your own Coda, so stockpile between rotations and buy the moment a good roll shows up.

conditions: Fusion takes the higher of the two bonuses × 1.1, capped at 60%.
Fuse into the copy holding your Forma and Catalyst; the donor's investments are destroyed.
Elemental Vice needs the weapon at rank 40 (5 Forma): 50,000 Hex standing at Rank 5, or 20 platinum, or a Temporal Archimedea/Nightwave drop.
